purpose: Natural robot-attention target definition on the laptop

action_plan.name: Empty camera view
action_plan.instruction: Remain completely outside the camera view

action_plan.name: Look at webcam lens
action_plan.instruction: Sit normally and look at the webcam lens

action_plan.name: Look at upper screen
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed marker directly below the webcam

action_plan.name: Look at screen centre
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed marker in the centre of the screen

action_plan.name: Look left away from laptop
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed LEFT away marker

action_plan.name: Look right away from laptop
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed RIGHT away marker

action_plan.name: Look above laptop
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed marker above the laptop

action_plan.name: Look down at keyboard
action_plan.instruction: Look down at the keyboard or unrelated lower object

note: Target categories are labelled, but physical target angles were not measured.
